claims.claim: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness was created 2026-08-13, is MIT-licensed, and had 269,030 stars and 32,667 forks on 2026-11-02.
The README calls dsh a developer preview and warns of compatibility-breaking changes; it is built on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture powered by Cordis.
SAFETY.md states the project has not undergone a security audit and that sandboxes and permission prompts do not guarantee isolation.

The sandbox package confines subprocesses with bwrap/Landlock on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS, and a restricted token on Windows, and describes confinement as same-world only (shares host kernel and filesystem).

arXiv:2608.25512 (submitted 2026-08-26; authors Shi, Zhang, Cui, with two at DeepSeek-AI) formalizes Cordis around temporal composability (revertible effects) and spatial composability (reactive coeffects).

DeepSeek API prices per 1M tokens: V4.1 Flash cache-hit $0.006, miss $0.30, output $1.20 at peak (half off-peak); V4 Pro $0.044/$1.32/$3.96 at peak; 1M context; peak windows 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri.
DeepSeek context caching is on by default, matches only fully matching prefix units, and is best-effort with no guaranteed hit rate.
Claude list prices per MTok: Opus 5.5 input $4, cache read $0.20, output $20; Sonnet 5.5 input $2, cache read $0.10, output $10.

DeepSeek's V4.1-Flash-1017 release notes say the model is tuned for DeepSeek Harness and recommend Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 or later, while the headline Terminal-Bench 4.0 score of 42.3 was measured with the Claude Code framework.
DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint maps claude-opus* names to deepseek-v4-pro and other claude* names to deepseek-flash, and DeepSeek documents running Claude Code against it.
A Composio benchmark reported by Atlas Cloud ran 8 harnesses on DeepSeek V4 Flash over 30 tasks, with pass rates from 46.7% to 66.7% and tokens per task from 192k to 1.4M.
The repo's benchmarks/ directory contains performance gates (e.g. session-open, terminal-io, conversation-fold), not model-accuracy or cross-harness results.

On 2026-10-15 a partial DeepSeek outage began at 08:11 Beijing time while a Bilibili account named DeepSeekHarness appeared with 10,000+ followers; the reporting says there is no official evidence linking the two.
Star counts on 2026-11-02: OpenClaw 393,695; DeepSeek Harness 269,030; OpenCode 223,978; Claude Code 154,233; Codex CLI 132,828.
